key_insight: SciForge is an AI-native scientific workbench that keeps human judgment in the UI while modular services handle multimodal translation, workflow execution, and auditable research state.
engineering_relevance: It offers a practical architecture for building research agents that can operate on papers, code, data, figures, and model outputs without losing provenance or collaborative decision context.
method: Goal-scoped decision governance with review gates and shared review surfaces
Translate-then-reason pipeline that routes scientific objects through domain-specific translators before agent reasoning
Evidence-DAG audit sidecar plus scientific model routing and workflow automation
evidence_signal: The abstract reports eight end-to-end user cases, including multi-day agentic sprints for gene discovery, protein design, molecular optimization, and genome-to-BGC discovery.
watch_item: The strongest collaboration features are still future-facing, since shared team workspaces are planned for later releases and the current system emphasizes desktop/mobile supervision.
paper_title: SciForge: An AI-Native, Multimodal Workbench for Scientific Discovery
